messages:
anya: quick FYI — AstraLedger LoRA merge into prod candidate dropped extraction accuracy after int4 quant. Suspect tokenizer mismatch (finite vocab diff).

bryce: any short repro we can run?

anya: run: `python -m eval_pack.run --pack astra_invoices_100 --model merged_astra_lora --quant int4`

li: paste tiny example?

anya: INPUT: "Invoice
Vendor: AstraLedger Inc."
FP16: "Vendor: AstraLedger Inc."
INT4: "Vendor: <unk>ledger Inc."
Token diff: "Astra" id 132 fp16 vs id 135 int4(post-merge).

nate: sounds like a deterministic id shift. Two fixes: remap LoRA indices to base vocab, or retokenize finetune and rebuild LoRA. Remap usually wins time-wise.

anya: I ran `tools/tokenmap/rebase_lora.py --in lora_astra.pt --map v1_to_v2.json --out lora_astra_rebase.pt` — completes. @eval-bot queue astra_invoices_100 for fp16, int4_raw, int4_rebased?

eval-bot: queued run 5332100490: astra_invoices_100 on merged_astra fp16,int4_raw,int4_rebased. ETA ~11m.

bryce: also check quant-block alignment when reindexing embeddings — shifting ids can move tokens across quant blocks.

nate: interim results: fp16 EM=0.88, int4_raw EM=0.53, int4_rebased EM=0.84. Rebase recovers most but 8 templates still fail (hyphenation/alias splits).

li: propose: (1) add tokenizer_fingerprint gate in merge CI, (2) add remap+optional calibrate step in merge pipeline, (3) add 40-adversarial alias templates to astra pack, (4) update SE onboarding note: "confirm tokenizer parity or supply remap.json."

anya: I'll open the PR with repro steps, the small adversarial set, and a regression test asserting EM drop <= 0.05 between fp16 and int4_rebased. Will attach run 5332100490 artifacts.

bryce: :thumbsup:
